title: NASA 'Moon Pigeons' report

tellings.quote: And yes, NASA published even a report in the early '7s called moon pigeons.

plain: NASA published a report in the early 1970s called "Moon Pigeons", according to Maaneli Derakhshani, who tells Michels this from his own reading. He gives only the title and rough date, saying nothing of what the report contains. He raises it as a sign that NASA had looked at something unusual about the Moon.
